mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating household demand, which reduces corporate revenue and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity and stronger corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals robust labor market expansion and higher corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals strengthening household demand and higher corporate revenue, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when RSAFS > 0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below -0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < -0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
